effects.name: White Flash
effects.description: Punchy full-white flash transition. Drop on a cut for a hard, energetic break between shots.

effects.name: RGB Split
effects.description: Animated chromatic channel split for a glitchy, digital-error look.
effects.implementationNote: Phase 1 sets static channel-source offsets and adds a position wiggle on the adjustment layer for visible motion. Animated per-frame channel offsets are planned for Phase 2 (see ROADMAP.md).

effects.name: Micro Shake
effects.description: Subtle high-frequency shake for adding low-key energy without distracting from the shot.

effects.name: CRT TV
effects.description: Classic CRT television look: crushed contrast, desaturated color and fine grain.

effects.name: Blue Night
effects.description: Cool, desaturated night-time color grade with lifted blue shadows.

effects.name: Split 2 Vertical
effects.description: Two side-by-side vertical columns. Select 2 layers, top-to-bottom = left-to-right. Select exactly 2 layers in the timeline first, then double-click.

effects.name: Split 2 Horizontal
effects.description: Two stacked horizontal rows. Select 2 layers, top-to-bottom = top-to-bottom. Select exactly 2 layers in the timeline first, then double-click.

effects.name: Split 3 Vertical
effects.description: Three side-by-side vertical columns, like the classic triptych edit. Select exactly 3 layers in the timeline first, then double-click.

effects.name: Split 3 Horizontal
effects.description: Three stacked horizontal rows. Select exactly 3 layers in the timeline first, then double-click.

effects.name: Split 4 Grid
effects.description: 2x2 grid of four panels. Select exactly 4 layers in the timeline first, then double-click.

effects.name: Reverse Clip
effects.description: Reverses the selected layer's playback direction using AE's native Time-Reverse Layer command. Select a layer first, then double-click.

effects.name: Speed Ramp (Slow to Fast)
effects.description: Classic build-up speed ramp - starts slow, accelerates into full speed. Select a layer first, then double-click.

effects.name: Speed Ramp (Fast to Slow)
effects.description: Impact-landing speed ramp - starts fast, eases into a slow finish. Select a layer first, then double-click.

effects.name: Speed Ramp (Freeze Punch)
effects.description: Holds on a frame, then punches into full speed - classic 'freeze then go' edit move. Select a layer first, then double-click.

effects.name: Zoom In Sustain
effects.description: Sustained push-in zoom that holds rather than snapping back - good for building tension into a moment.

effects.name: Zoom Out Push
effects.description: Starts zoomed in and pulls back to normal - a reveal-style zoom out.

effects.name: Zoom Blur Whip
effects.description: Fast zoom punch combined with a blur pulse for a whip-zoom transition feel.

effects.name: Zoom Shake Combo
effects.description: Zoom punch combined with a quick shake for an energetic hybrid hit.

effects.name: Handheld Drift
effects.description: Slow, low-amplitude drift simulating a handheld camera - much gentler and slower than the Shakes category.

effects.name: Slow Push In
effects.description: Gradual, cinematic push-in over the full duration - simulates a slow dolly/zoom rather than a quick punch.

effects.name: Pan Drift
effects.description: Slow lateral drift simulating a gentle pan across the frame.

effects.name: Whip Pan
effects.description: Fast snap-pan with a blur pulse timed to the motion - classic whip-pan transition feel.

effects.name: Classic B&W
effects.description: Clean, full desaturation with gentle contrast - a neutral classic black and white look.

effects.name: High Contrast B&W
effects.description: Harsh, punchy black and white with crushed shadows and bright highlights - dramatic editorial look.

effects.name: Faded B&W
effects.description: Washed-out, lifted-black film look in monochrome.

effects.name: Noir B&W
effects.description: Moody crushed-shadow noir look with film grain.

effects.name: Earthquake Shake
effects.description: Extreme, sustained low-frequency shake with big amplitude - chaos for the full clip rather than a quick hit.

effects.name: Bass Shake
effects.description: Punchy low-frequency shake for hitting bass drops - bigger amplitude, slower frequency than Micro Shake.

effects.name: Performance Shake
effects.description: Medium-amplitude, medium-frequency shake for energetic performance footage - between Micro Shake and Bass Shake in intensity.

effects.name: Heavy Impact Shake
effects.description: Sharp, large-amplitude shake for a single hard impact moment - short duration, high intensity.

effects.name: Strobe Shake
effects.description: Chaotic shake combined with a rapid opacity strobe - maximum energy, very short burst.

effects.name: Glitch Shake
effects.description: Shake and digital glitch hybrid - channel split plus a hard jitter for maximum chaos.

effects.name: Bass Hit
effects.description: Big impact moment - zoom punch combined with a quick white flash, timed for a bass drop or hard hit.
effects.notes: Uses Fill's OWN Opacity property (not the layer's master transform.Opacity) for the flash, specifically so the zoom punch - a separate effect on the same layer - keeps its full effect throughout. The layer's master Opacity scales the WHOLE effect stack uniformly, so using it for the flash would have also killed the zoom punch at the same moments.

effects.name: Snare Hit
effects.description: Smaller, snappier impact than Bass Hit - quick scale tick and a brief flash, for lighter percussive hits.

effects.name: Drop Hit
effects.description: The biggest hit in the category - large zoom punch plus a sharp shake burst, for the drop moment.
effects.notes: Position expression decays the wiggle amplitude over the first 0.25s so the shake burst fades out rather than running the full duration at full strength.

effects.name: Black Flash
effects.description: Hard black flash transition - punchier, darker cousin of White Flash.

effects.name: RGB Flash
effects.description: Rapid red-green-blue color flash cycle for a high-energy cut transition.

effects.name: Blur Transition
effects.description: Smooth blur pulse for a soft transition between shots.

effects.name: Flash Pan
effects.description: White flash combined with a quick directional pan - a punchier alternative to a plain flash cut.

effects.name: Glitch Cut
effects.description: Very short, sharp glitch burst for cutting between shots - noise and channel split with no flash.

effects.name: Zoom Transition
effects.description: Quick punch-zoom transition - scale snaps up and settles back to normal.

effects.name: Dirty CRT
effects.description: Heavier, grimier CRT look - more grain and contrast crush than the base CRT TV preset.

effects.name: VHS CRT
effects.description: VHS tape wobble combined with a CRT color/grain treatment.

effects.name: Analog Damage
effects.description: Combined tape-damage look - wave warp wobble, channel split, and heavy noise.

effects.name: Digital Glitch
effects.description: Blocky digital corruption look - posterized color with a sharp positional jitter.

effects.name: Signal Loss
effects.description: Flickering broadcast signal-loss look - rapid opacity flicker over heavy noise and crushed contrast.

effects.name: Datamosh Style
effects.description: Choppy, compression-artifact-style look approximating a datamosh stutter using frame-rate posterization and wave distortion.

effects.name: Blood Look
effects.description: Intense red-pushed color grade with crushed blacks - horror/intensity aesthetic.

effects.name: Luxury Look
effects.description: Warm, soft-contrast premium grade with gently lifted highlights.

effects.name: Dark Trap
effects.description: Moody, desaturated trap-music aesthetic with crushed blacks and a cool purple/green shadow tint.

effects.name: Random B&W Hits
effects.description: Punches brief black & white flashes into random short windows across your clip - a few random frames at a time, never the same pattern twice. Select a layer first.

effects.name: Motion Blur Whip
effects.description: Real directional motion blur (not a fake Gaussian pulse) snapping through a quick whip - Blur Length and Direction are both keyframed, so you can restyle the whole motion by hand.

effects.name: Crash Zoom Hard
effects.description: The hardest zoom in the library - a violent punch-in with real motion blur riding the curve, not just a scale snap.

effects.name: Chroma Flash Hit
effects.description: RGB color-cycle flash with a motion-blur lead-in - hits harder than a plain flash cut.

effects.name: Laggy Energy Shake
effects.description: Shake combined with frame-rate posterization for that choppy, low-frame-rate energy look - feels broken on purpose.
